description.purpose: Persistent memory: thread (loop fan-in rows per 14b protocol), answers (archived results + remember-tool inserts) and searches tables.
description.use_when: Sink for the archive cell and the planner's remember tool; queryable via store-native select args.
description.not_in_scope: No vector search, no ranking — plain SQLite tables.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one tool_result per operation. hop.operation/rows_affected for routing; SQL failures are normal tool_results with hop.error_code.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: tool_call turns with store-native args {operation, table, ...}; select requires an explicit columns array.
examples: {operation: insert, table: answers, row: {...}} -> tool_result 'ok', hop {operation: 'insert', rows_affected: 1}
